title: 7 Cheapest New Trucks You Can Buy in 2027 (Which One Is Worth It)
description:
You can still buy a new pickup truck for less than thirty thousand dollars in America. But there is a catch, and it is the reason most buyers never find that price. One of these trucks is being phased out, according to reports. One has the best resale value of any truck we checked. And one of the cheapest trucks in America might not be built yet. Here are the cheapest new trucks, and which one is worth buying.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
2:07 1. Slate
3:18 2. Ford Maverick
4:23 3. Hyundai Santa Cruz
5:57 4. Toyota Tacoma
7:36 5. Chevrolet Colorado
8:43 6. Ford Ranger
9:54 7. Nissan Frontier
15:23 The verdict
20:22 What to check before you buy in 2027

Sources:
For the prices, we used the Autoblog list of the ten cheapest trucks, published in June of twenty twenty-six. We cross-checked it with SlashGear, from May. Where the two disagree, we say so. For the sales, we used the nine-month table from Pickup Truck Talk. For resale value, we used iSeeCars. A starting price is the price of the cheapest trim, and it usually does not include the destination fee. Every source is listed in the description.

Photos from Wikimedia Commons, full credits and licenses: https://github.com/viniciushoscher-ctrl/american-trucks/blob/main/agendamento/creditos/video09.md
